summary: Normalize defaults a zero page_size to DefaultPageSize (20) and returns an error naming the value when page_size is outside 1-100. TestNormalize covers the default and the -1 and 101 cases. No defects found.

criteria.evidence: settings.go Normalize sets PageSize = DefaultPageSize (20) when 0 and returns nil; TestNormalize asserts no error and PageSize == DefaultPageSize; evidence/criterion-1.jsonl.
Normalize returns fmt.Errorf("settings: page_size %d is outside 1-100", s.PageSize), which names 101; TestNormalize checks 101 returns an error; evidence/criterion-2.jsonl.
